title: Solving Equations
description: Solving one-step and two-step linear equations using inverse operations and the balance method.

notes.heading: What is an Equation?
notes.body: An equation has an equals sign and states two expressions are equal. Think of a balanced scale — left must equal right. The solution is the value that makes it true. x+3=10 has solution x=7. Equations differ from expressions: 2x+5 is an expression; 2x+5=13 is an equation.

notes.heading: Solving One-Step Equations
notes.body: Use the inverse operation to isolate the variable. Golden rule: whatever you do to one side, do EXACTLY the same to the other. Addition ↔ Subtraction, Multiplication ↔ Division. Examples: x+5=12 → x=7; y−3=8 → y=11; 4n=20 → n=5; m/3=7 → m=21. Always check by substituting back.

notes.heading: Solving Two-Step Equations
notes.body: Undo addition/subtraction first, then multiplication/division (SADMEP — reverse of PEMDAS). Example: 3x+4=19 → subtract 4: 3x=15 → divide by 3: x=5. Example: 2p−7=11 → add 7: 2p=18 → divide by 2: p=9.

notes.heading: Forming Equations from Word Problems
notes.body: Steps: (1) Identify the unknown, give it a letter. (2) Translate the situation into an equation. (3) Solve. (4) Answer in context with units. Example: "I think of a number, multiply by 4, add 7, get 35." Let n be the number: 4n+7=35 → 4n=28 → n=7.

notes.heading: ⚠️ Don't forget the equals sign balance
notes.body: If you subtract 4 from the left side, you must subtract 4 from the right side too. Writing each step on a new line helps you remember to do the same thing to both sides.

notes.heading: ✅ Check your answer
notes.body: After solving, substitute your answer back into the original equation. If both sides are equal, your solution is correct. Example: for 3x + 2 = 14, x = 4. Check: 3(4) + 2 = 14 ✓.

questions.explanation: To solve y − 5 = 12, add 5 to both sides: y = 12 + 5 = 17. Check: 17 − 5 = 12 ✓.

questions.stem: I think of a number, multiply by 3, subtract 4, get 20. Find the number.
Perimeter of rectangle is 38cm, length 12cm. Find width. (P=2l+2w)
A football team scores 3 goals in each of its first n games and has scored 21 goals in total. How many games has it played?
questions.explanation: 3n = 21. Divide both sides by 3: n = 7. So the team has played 7 games.

questions.stem: The equation ax = 10 has the solution x = 5. What number is a?
questions.explanation: Substitute x = 5 into ax = 10: a × 5 = 10. Divide both sides by 5: a = 2. Check: 2 × 5 = 10 ✓.

questions.stem: A rectangle's length is (2x + 1) cm and its width is 5 cm. The perimeter is 28 cm. Find x.
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(length + width): 2((2x+1)+5)=28. Simplify: 2(2x+6)=28 → 4x+12=28 → 4x=16 → x=4. Check: length=9, width=5, perimeter=28 ✓.
